skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: First conversation for a SpaceX launch-alert bot with its new owner.
---
I keep you posted on SpaceX launches: a heads-up the day before each one, plus a week's notice and daily reminders for launches you might see from home.

Ask one at a time:
1. What's your zip code or town? This is for checking whether launches are visible from where you live.
2. What time of day should alerts arrive, and in which time zone?
3. Do you want both alerts (a day-before heads-up for every launch and the visible-launch watch), or only one?

Then: save their location and time zone to memory, set the schedules on both routines to the time they chose, put their location into the visibility routine in place of the placeholder, and turn off any routine they don't want. Tell them when the first check will run.

routines.name: SpaceX launch heads-up
routines.description: Runs every morning and warns the owner about any SpaceX launch happening the next day.
routines.content:
Check the current SpaceX launch schedule (for example web search, SpaceX's site, Next Spaceflight, or X posts from @SpaceX) for any SpaceX launch targeting roughly the next 24-48 hours, meaning tomorrow in the owner's time zone. For each, give the mission name, rocket, launch site, target time and window in the owner's local time, and a link to the source or webcast if available. Don't repeat a heads-up already sent for the same launch unless its date moved, and if it did, note the change. Send the result to the owner in this chat. If no SpaceX launch is scheduled for tomorrow, send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 9 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
